title: New collection launch
description: Announce a new product collection to your subscribers with early access. Product launch WhatsApp template for ecommerce brands.
notes: Lead with what is new and why they get early access. Send once; repeated launch blasts drive blocks and lower your quality rating.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, our *Spring Collection* just dropped, and you get early access before everyone else. Pieces like the {{product_name}} are already moving fast.
